name: budget-app-motter
description: Daniel Motter budgeting app — website + shared API monorepo (Christian debt-free stewardship framing)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @motter/api" "npm run dev -w @motter/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @motter/shared && npm run build -w @motter/api-client && npm run build -w @motter/api && npm run build -w @motter/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @motter/web --if-present && npm run lint -w @motter/api --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @motter/shared && npm run build -w @motter/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @motter/api && npm run typecheck -w @motter/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next packages/*/dist node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
